source.section: Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 14, Railroad Retirement (IN-112 Instructions PDF p.4 Line 14; booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), rate schedules (booklet PDF p.46)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 30,020.00 + Railroad Retirement Tier 2 annuity (person 0) 24,000.00 = 54,020.00. Federal taxable income = 54,020.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 36,270.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Single: Line 1 federal AGI 54,020.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Subtractions: Line 14 Railroad Retirement 24,000.00; Line 18 total subtractions 24,000.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 24,000.00 = -24,000.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 -24,000.00; Line 3 = 54,020.00 + (-24,000.00) = 30,020.00. Line 4 standard deduction 7,650.00 + 1 x 1,250.00 age box(es) = 8,900.00 [person 0 born 1958-04-18 (65 or older: box checked)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 1; Line 5e 1 x 5,300.00 = 5,300.00. Line 6 = 8,900.00 + 5,300.00 = 14,200.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 30,020.00 - 14,200.00 = 15,820.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 15,820.00 (Schedule X, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (15,820.00 - 0.00) = 529.97; the tax table (pp.47-51) gives 531. Federal AGI 54,020.00 is not greater than 150,000.00, so no minimum tax: Line 8 529.97. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 529.97; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 529.97.
accepted_approximations: The rate schedule is one continuous schedule: the printed rows that restart at 75,000 are merged and printed base taxes, rounded to the dollar, are not used. Below 75,000 the booklet uses tax tables in 100 dollar rows.
